performance_plan.purpose: Validate an exact, memory-safe process-parallel collection profile before the frozen K=8 post-15315 rebuild is allowed to run at production scale.
frozen_pass_requirements: All tested collection thread profiles reproduce the canonical 8-thread sample identities/order and collection reports exactly.
Four-process member-shaped collection reproduces serial sample identities/order and reports exactly.
Repeated canonical mini-fit reproduces collection, loss sequence digest, and final model tensor digest exactly.
Actual parallel collection speedup is at least 1.25x.
Projected end-to-end speedup including unchanged fit cost is at least 1.25x.
Projected net savings for K=8 are at least 1800 seconds.
Minimum MemAvailable is at least 4 GiB.
Maximum swap used is at most 1 GiB.
Collection workers never deserialize the multi-GB 10105 checkpoint.
performance_plan.authorization_if_pass: Implement the K=8 production runner with the selected exact collection thread profile, four independent collection workers, canonical 8-thread fits, the frozen member seeds, and no scientific threshold change.
exclusions: No rebuild member is admitted by this performance PASS.
No member weighting, dropping, reseeding, or post-hoc selection is allowed.
